title: MITIGATING DATASET BIAS BY USING PER-SAMPLE GRADIENT
reasoning: The paper benchmarks its debiasing method on the CivilComments-WILDS dataset, which involves identifying toxic comments. The dataset contains spurious correlations between toxicity and mentions of religious identities such as 'Muslim' and 'Christian'. Evaluating the model's performance in mitigating this bias constitutes an ethical benchmark concerning fairness towards religious groups.
